title: EFC -- Master Specification (v1 Archive)
abstract: Archived v1 master specification of Energy-Flow Cosmology. Represents the earliest complete formulation including initial field definitions, conceptual structure, and primary thermodynamic foundations. Preserved for historical reference, reproducibility, and comparison with later versions.
key_results: First complete formulation of EFC field equations
Initial entropy field definition with sigmoid form
Baseline for comparison with v2.x and later versions
